title: Cyberbullying Detection: Exploring Datasets, Technologies, and Approaches on Social Media Platforms

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review of existing cyberbullying detection datasets and approaches to identify the overrepresentation of high-resource languages (e.g., English) and the algorithmic performance disparities when detecting instances in low-resource languages.

Evaluating literature to assess how cultural variations, regional norms, and contextual nuances affect the subjective definition and algorithmic misinterpretation of cyberbullying behaviors across different demographics.

Analyzing the ratio of cyberbullying to non-cyberbullying instances in public datasets to identify how majority-class dominance causes models to become biased toward predicting the non-bullying class.
